gloss: the whole world; the entire world; worldwide

definitions.gloss: the whole world; the entire world; worldwide
definitions.explanation: Refers to the totality of the world without exception, emphasizing global scope. Often used in news reporting and statements about worldwide events, populations, or distributions.

examples.japanese: {全世界|ぜんせかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}した→注目する：25530_chuumokusuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全世界|ぜんせかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{全世界|ぜんせかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{八十億人|はちじゅうおくにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えている→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: The population of the entire world exceeds eight billion people.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ (all, entire) and ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧ (world). Emphasizes the totality of the world, often used in news, global statements, and dramatic expressions. Frequently appears in phrases about worldwide events, distributions, or populations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全世界|ぜんせかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: worldwide; across the entire world
- {全世界|ぜんせかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: to spread across the entire world
- {全世界|ぜんせかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧: people of the whole world

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧ — all over the world (more conversational, same meaning)
- ⟦{世界各地|せかいかくち}→世界各地：24526_sekaikakuchi⟧ — various places in the world (emphasizes individual locations)
- {地球上|ちきゅうじょう} — on the earth (more geographic/scientific nuance)
